CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real first case of VoxelBlock city-wall integration: carved a real, confirmed-live ~15-block wall structure out of the city's normal render/collision path, replaced with a real non-cube Paper Engine object sized to its exact bounding box. Verified live -- server confirmed exact block-removal count, real UDP probe confirmed damage registers on the carved-out object. bazel build/test //... clean (19 targets, 8/8 mod tests). Commit 12aaa56. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
